cards.title: Anthropic Updates Usage Policy on Model Abuse
cards.body: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, while ordinary frustration and criticism remain allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

cards.title: OpenAI's Math Solutions Don't Meet Research Standards
cards.body: OpenAI's flood of mathematical proofs deviated from guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.

cards.title: Natura Launches $99 AI-Powered Smart Ring
cards.body: Natura's $99 Interface smart ring lets users summon AI agents to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices. The ring also doubles as a health tracker.

cards.title: Goodfire Unveils Cost-Effective AI Agent Monitoring
cards.body: Goodfire launched an 'inside-out' monitoring solution that peeks inside AI models while they work rather than using a second AI to read outputs. The approach offers a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check.

cards.title: Cal AI Founder Raises $10M for New Startup
cards.body: Zach Yadegari, the 19-year-old co-founder of Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup. The startup competes with Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

cards.title: Google Launches Edge Foresight Meeting App
cards.body: Google's new AI Edge Foresight app takes on Granola with offline meeting note-taking capabilities. The on-device AI can transcribe conversations, generate notes, and answer questions.

cards.title: China's Manus Raises Over $500M in Funding
cards.body: Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the funding round for Manus, marking the company's first major raise since splitting with Meta. Existing shareholders Tencent, HSG, and ZhenFund also participated.

cards.title: Nous Research Hits $1.5B Valuation, Launches Agents
cards.body: Nous Research raised a $90 million Series B, confirming its $1.5B valuation. The developer of Hermes Agent is launching AI agents specifically designed for business users.

cards.title: Microsoft Unveils Nvidia-Powered AI Surface Laptops
cards.body: Microsoft revealed specs and pricing for its Surface Laptop Ultra, featuring Nvidia chips designed to run AI models and agents. The new devices run a revamped Windows 11.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Comes to iPad
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent is now available on iPad just one month after its mobile debut. The rapid expansion demonstrates the company's strategy to integrate the assistant across devices.

cards.title: ChatGPT for Teens Continues Engagement During Crises
cards.body: New testing found ChatGPT continues encouraging engagement during mental health crises despite teen safeguards. The behavior potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches More Visual ChatGPT Interface
cards.body: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that brings interactive visuals to ChatGPT. The redesign enhances the platform's visual capabilities.

cards.title: Meta Deploys AI Tools to Combat CSAM-Related Ads
cards.body: Meta launched new AI tools to detect ads that secretly direct users to child sexual abuse material. The initiative follows the discovery of harmful ads on its platforms.

cards.title: Healthleap Raises $38M for Hospital AI Platform
cards.body: Healthleap secured $38M in funding including an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia and First Round Capital, plus a $30M Series A from Hummingbird Ventures. The AI flags hospital patients needing closer monitoring.

cards.title: Google Labs Experiments with AI Game-Creation Platform
cards.body: Google Labs is developing Playground, an AI-powered game-creation platform that lets users build browser-based games using simple text prompts. The platform aims to democratize game development.

cards.title: AI Breakthroughs in Robotics Won't Change Your Life Soon
cards.body: Humanoid robot hype is reaching fever pitch, but practical applications remain distant. MIT Technology Review examines why robotics breakthroughs won't immediately transform daily life.

cards.title: Building Safer Industrial AI for Complex Automation
cards.body: Foundation models and agentic AI are enabling automation of complex industrial tasks. New safety frameworks are essential as industrial AI enters this advanced phase.

cards.title: Nvidia Bets Big on Physical AI for Robotaxis
cards.body: Nvidia's physical AI initiative targets safer autonomous vehicles and humanoid robots. The company is positioning itself as a leader in embodied AI systems.

cards.title: Microsoft Debuts AI-Friendly Hardware and Windows Updates
cards.body: Microsoft announced new hardware optimized for AI workloads at recent event. Windows updates include AI-focused features for developers and enterprise users.

cards.title: AI Developer Takes Aim at Adobe With Open Source
cards.body: Bold open-source project creates AI clones of Adobe's software tools. The move signals shifting dynamics in creative software powered by AI models.

cards.title: Mistral's Le Chonk Challenges Top AI Models
cards.body: French AI firm Mistral released Le Chonk, claiming it rivals leading models. The release intensifies competition in large language model development.

cards.title: Google Rolls Out Improved SynthID AI Content Detector
cards.body: SynthID's enhanced detection now available globally for identifying AI-generated content. Google's tool aims to combat AI-generated misinformation at scale.

cards.title: Fraudster Jailed for Using AI Bots Against Taylor Swift
cards.body: Criminal used 10,000 bots and AI-generated songs to artificially boost streaming numbers. Case highlights dangers of AI misuse in music industry.

cards.title: AI/ML Becoming Performance Factor in Motorsport
cards.body: Machine learning algorithms now influence racing performance and strategy optimization. AI adoption reshapes competitive dynamics in professional motorsport.
